questions.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a high point of the Gupta period?
options: The development of the first Indian currency
The canonisation of Hindu epics and literary sources
The production of scholars such as Kalidasa and Aryabhata
Achievements in architecture, sculpture, and painting
answer_explanations: Correct. The article mentions cultural developments, scholars, and achievements in architecture, sculpture, and painting, but does not reference the development of the first Indian currency.
Incorrect. The article states that many Hindu epics and literary sources, such as the Mahabharata and Ramayana, were canonised during this period.
Incorrect. The article highlights the Gupta period produced scholars such as Kalidasa, Aryabhata, Varahamihira, and Vatsyayana.
Incorrect. The article notes that the period gave rise to achievements in architecture, sculpture, and painting that set standards of form and taste.

questions.question: According to the article, which region is identified as the possible ancestral territory of the Guptas?
options: Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Magadha (Bihar), and Bengal
The Deccan Plateau
The Indus Valley
Punjab
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that they originated somewhere in the Gangetic plains: eastern Uttar Pradesh, Magadha (Bihar), and Bengal have been variously proposed as their homeland.
Incorrect. The Deccan Plateau is not mentioned as a proposed ancestral territory of the Guptas.
Incorrect. The Indus Valley is not mentioned as a possible ancestral territory of the Guptas.
Incorrect. Punjab is not mentioned as a proposed ancestral territory of the Guptas.

questions.question: Which title was used for Chandragupta I, indicating his higher status compared to his predecessors?
options: Maharajadhiraja
Maharaja
Raja
Samrat
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says that in the Allahabad Pillar inscription, Chandragupta I is called a Maharajadhiraja (King of Great Kings), while his predecessor Gupta and Ghatotkacha are described as Maharaja.
Incorrect. Maharaja was used for Gupta and Ghatotkacha, not Chandragupta I.
Incorrect. The title Raja is not specifically mentioned in the article for Chandragupta I.
Incorrect. Samrat is not mentioned as a title for Chandragupta I in the article.

questions.question: Which of the following foreign groups invaded and contributed to the decline of the Gupta Empire?
options: The Huna peoples (Kidarites and Alchon Huns)
The Romans
The Greeks
The Persians
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the empire eventually died out due to factors such as the invasion by the Huna peoples (Kidarites and Alchon Huns) from Central Asia.
Incorrect. The Romans are not mentioned as invaders in the article.
Incorrect. The Greeks are not mentioned as invaders in the article.
Incorrect. The Persians are not mentioned as invaders in the article.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the religious tolerance of the Gupta rulers?
options: They followed Hinduism but tolerated other faiths
They enforced strict adherence to Hinduism
They were exclusively Buddhist
They were secular and banned all religions
answer_explanations: Correct. The article mentions that Hinduism was followed by the rulers and the Brahmins flourished, but the Guptas were tolerant towards people of other faiths as well.
Incorrect. The article does not state that they enforced strict adherence to Hinduism.
Incorrect. The article does not claim they were exclusively Buddhist.
Incorrect. The article does not mention that they banned all religions.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a region that paid tribute to Samudragupta?
options: Samatata
Davaka
Magadha
Kamarupa
answer_explanations: Correct. The article lists several frontier kingdoms and tribal aristocracies that paid tribute to Samudragupta, including Samatata, Davaka, Kamarupa, Nepal, Karttripura, Malavas, Arjunayanas, Yaudheyas, Madrakas, and Abhiras. Magadha is not listed among them.
Incorrect. Samatata is mentioned as one of the polities that paid tribute to Samudragupta.
Incorrect. Davaka is mentioned as one of the polities that paid tribute to Samudragupta.
Incorrect. Kamarupa is mentioned as one of the polities that paid tribute to Samudragupta.

questions.question: Which of the following scholars is NOT mentioned as having lived during the Gupta period?
options: Kalidasa
Aryabhata
Varahamihira
Chanakya
answer_explanations: Correct. The article mentions Kalidasa, Aryabhata, Varahamihira, and Vatsyayana as scholars from the Gupta period. Chanakya is not mentioned.
Incorrect. Kalidasa is mentioned as a scholar from the Gupta period.
Incorrect. Aryabhata is mentioned as a scholar from the Gupta period.
Incorrect. Varahamihira is mentioned as a scholar from the Gupta period.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the significance of the Gupta period in art and architecture?
options: It set standards of form and taste that determined the subsequent course of art, not only in India but far beyond its borders
It was the first time art was used for religious purposes
It was limited to religious sculptures only
It was heavily influenced by foreign art styles
answer_explanations: Correct. The article quotes that the period gave rise to achievements in architecture, sculpture, and painting that 'set standards of form and taste [that] determined the whole subsequent course of art, not only in India but far beyond her borders'.
Incorrect. The article does not state that it was the first time art was used for religious purposes.
Incorrect. The article does not limit the significance to religious sculptures only.
Incorrect. The article does not claim that Gupta art was heavily influenced by foreign art styles.

questions.question: Which of the following is mentioned as a reason for the Guptas' possible Vaishya origin?
options: Ancient Indian texts prescribe the name 'Gupta' for members of the Vaishya varna
The Guptas were known for their extensive trade networks
The Guptas were recorded as having a Vaishya caste symbol
The Guptas were recorded as having a Vaishya religious text
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that some historians, such as A.S. Altekar, have theorised that they were of Vaishya origin, as certain ancient Indian texts prescribe the name 'Gupta' for the members of the Vaishya varna.
Incorrect. The article does not mention extensive trade networks as a reason for their possible Vaishya origin.
Incorrect. The article does not mention a Vaishya caste symbol.
Incorrect. The article does not mention a Vaishya religious text.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the role of the Chinese traveler Yijing in identifying the Guptas' origin?
options: He provided a temple location that suggested a Bengal origin
He documented the Guptas' military conquests
He recorded the Guptas' religious practices
He wrote about the Guptas' economic policies
answer_explanations: Correct. The article explains that Yijing, a 7th century Chinese traveler, recorded that king Che-li-ki-to (identified with the dynasty's founder Shri-gupta) built a temple at Mi-li-kia-si-kia-po-no, which Yijing states was located more than 40 yojanas east of Nalanda, suggesting a Bengal location.
Incorrect. Yijing did not document the Guptas' military conquests.
Incorrect. Yijing did not record the Guptas' religious practices.
Incorrect. Yijing did not write about the Guptas' economic policies.
